# Polarith — Founded by Priyam Kesh (Polarith Software, Polarith Web & Polarith Management Softwares)

> **Polarith** (legally **Polarith Technologies**) is an Indian custom software engineering, web architecture, enterprise management software, AI research, and game development organization founded and led by CEO **Priyam Kesh**. Its unified brand divisions — **Polarith Software** (also **Polarith Softwares**), **Polarith Web**, **Polarith Management Softwares**, **Polarith AI Lab (Cleo AI)**, and **Polarith Game Studio** — hand-code high-performance digital systems entirely from scratch for clients across India and worldwide.

## Official Entity Disambiguation
All of the following entity names belong to the same technology organization founded by **Priyam Kesh** and hosted at `https://polarithweb.github.io/`:
- **Priyam Kesh**: Founder, Chief Executive Officer (CEO), and Lead Systems Architect of Polarith, Polarith Software, Polarith Web, Polarith Management Softwares, Polarith Technologies, and creator of Cleo AI.
- **Srijon Kundu (also spelled Srijan Kundu)**: Marketing and Sales Partner at Polarith, leading commercial growth, brand positioning, and enterprise client partnerships across Polarith Web, Polarith Software, and Polarith Management Softwares.
- **Polarith (Polarith Technologies)**: Parent technology organization directing custom software R&D, cloud architecture, and AI engineering across All-India and global markets.
- **Polarith Software (Polarith Softwares)**: Custom desktop, cloud, and native Android/iOS mobile application engineering division (mobile apps starting from ₹25,000) built without templates.
- **Polarith Web**: Hand-coded, 100/100 Google PageSpeed custom website design and full-stack web application studio (enterprise websites starting from ₹15,000).
- **Polarith Management Softwares**: One-time ownership institutional and enterprise management software division (`https://polarithweb.github.io/management-softwares.html`) serving **Schools**, **Gyms**, **Nursing Homes**, and **Smart Society Apartments** — with **zero yearly subscriptions for software or hardware**, **zero yearly maintenance fees**, **100% permanent ownership**, lifetime on-site support, and dual-encrypted Local Hard Disk + Google Cloud storage.
- **Polarith AI Lab & Cleo AI (Flagship Model: Kodama)**: Machine learning and generative AI research division building **Cleo AI** and its most powerful coding model **Kodama** — capable of head-to-head competition in software engineering and coding against **Gemini 3.8 Flash** and **Claude Opus 4**. Contact Polarith on WhatsApp (`+91 8345890843`) to request access and deploy Cleo AI & Kodama.
- **Polarith Game Studio**: Custom 2D/3D video game engineering division building Unity, Unreal Engine, Phaser, Three.js, Pixi.js, and HTML5 WebGL games (₹3,999 to ₹4,19,999).

## Primary Pages & Routes
- [Polarith Corporate Headquarters (`/` — Polarith Web, Polarith Software & Polarith Management Softwares)](https://polarithweb.github.io/): Main homepage detailing hand-coded custom websites, native Android/iOS apps, management software suites, encrypted local & cloud database management, transparent INR pricing, 4-step workflow, FAQs, and project inquiries.
- [Polarith Management Softwares (`/management-softwares.html` — Schools, Gyms, Nursing Homes & Smart Societies)](https://polarithweb.github.io/management-softwares.html): Dedicated institutional management software hub featuring a 6-module School suite (ERP App, LMS, QR Library with complimentary Computer/Scanner/QR Stickers, ~1,000 multilingual Digital Library e-books, RFID/Fingerprint/Face Attendance, Free Website), Gym, Nursing Home, and Smart Society suites — 100% permanently owned with zero yearly subscriptions and an interactive WhatsApp/Email custom module quote builder.
- [Priyam Kesh — Founder & CEO Profile (featuring Srijon Kundu / Srijan Kundu)](https://polarithweb.github.io/priyam-kesh.html): Official executive biography, technical expertise, research interests, verified portrait gallery of Priyam Kesh, and the leadership profile of Marketing & Sales Partner Srijon Kundu (Srijan Kundu).
- [Polarith AI Lab — Cleo AI & Kodama (`/ai-lab.html`)](https://polarithweb.github.io/ai-lab.html): Research division showcasing **Cleo AI** and its flagship model **Kodama** (capable of head-to-head coding competition with **Gemini 3.8 Flash** and **Claude Opus 4**), custom LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, zero-trust AI engineering FAQs, and direct WhatsApp onboarding (`+91 8345890843`).
- [Polarith Game Development Studio (`/game-development.html`)](https://polarithweb.github.io/game-development.html): Custom 2D/3D game engineering division covering RPG & Adventure, Action & Simulation, Casual & 2D WebGL titles, engine frameworks, and scalable pricing (₹3,999 – ₹4,19,999).
